hero.description: I turn ideas into scalable digital products, focusing on real-world impact.

paragraphs.introduction: My name is João Vitor, and I am a software engineer. I have always been passionate about technology and believe in its power to simplify and create opportunities.
paragraphs.impact: I enjoy solving real problems and turning them into products that make a positive impact on people's lives.
paragraphs.growth: I am curious, persistent, and always looking for new learning opportunities, challenges, and people who share this vision.
